newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen consolidating amid profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen consolidating amid profit-taking.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may see profit-taking after a lingering bullish trend supported by good buying by retail investors, brokers said.

"The share prices rose sharply over the past several sessions. There is no reason other than the current political stability and few of the government steps to woo investors," said one broker. Broker said investors might book profit on food, cement and engineering stocks which made sharp gains over the sessions.
The DSE benchmark index closed 104.09 points or 5.82 percent up at 1890.36 taka on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
